en-US.description: QOwnNotes is the open source notepad with markdown support and todo list manager
en-US.name: QOwnNotes
en-US.releaseNotes:
26.10.14
- Added export of selected notes to individual PDFs from the note list context menu
  (for #994,
  #3821, thank you, @serebryakov02)
  - Choose the destination folder and page settings once for all selected notes
  - Existing PDFs are preserved by using numbered filenames
- Added clickable <details> / <summary> sections to both note preview backends,
  including nested sections and initially expanded sections with open
  (for #3818)
  - Expansion state is preserved while editing the current note
  - HTML exports keep native disclosure markup; printing and PDF export include all content
- Failed CalDAV task saves now show an error and leave the cached task unchanged,
  instead of making rejected edits appear saved after refreshing the task list
  (for #3815)
  - Apply the same protection to new tasks, completion changes, and task moves
  - Only close the task dialog after a successful save
  - Save and insert only inserts the task link after the save succeeds
- Added a Windows installer QOwnNotes.msi to the releases, next to the
  QOwnNotes.zip archive, so QOwnNotes can be installed without unzipping
  - It installs QOwnNotes for the current user, without administration permissions,
    adds a start menu shortcut and keeps the automatic updater working
- There was a new release of the QOwnNotes Web Companion browser extension
  2026.10.0
  - Context-menu actions now open the setup popup when user data consent or the security
    token is missing (for #122)
  - The popup now has a minimum height so dialogs display properly even with few or no
    bookmarks, including searches with no results
  - Updated dependencies
- There was a new release of the QOwnNotesAPI Nextcloud App,
  v26.8.1
  - QOwnNotesAPI is now deprecated; Nextcloud users are encouraged to switch to
    QOwnNotes for Nextcloud
  - Read the migration guide
    for installation and client compatibility requirements before removing QOwnNotesAPI
  - QOwnNotes for Nextcloud does not support ownCloud, so ownCloud users cannot migrate to it
- qc v0.7.0 was released
  - qc switch now uses the configured searchable selector to choose a note folder,
    marking the current folder and using a bordered layout with fzf
    (for #25)
  - Pressing Ctrl + C exits with code 130 without printing an error,
    including when cancelling snippet selection (for #1)
Released files
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage: Portable Linux AppImage build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the AppImage
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Snap package
- QOwnNotes-Qt5-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 5 for older environments
- QOwnNotes-Qt5-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 5 Snap package
- QOwnNotes.zip: Windows ZIP package built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256sum: Alternative SHA-256 checksum file for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.msi: Windows installer built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.msi.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows installer
- QOwnNotes.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotesQt5.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 5 for older systems
